  ¬c.target ≤ c.count + 1 →
    ¬(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q - (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.trace q O seed ω k).iteration) *
                max (q.n * q.m) q.S +
              (c.target - (c.count + 1)) +
            1 ≤
          (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q - (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.trace q O seed ω k).iteration) *
              max (q.n * q.m) q.S +

      False
